text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "In regular meetings with internal and external bodies, the Safety Office identifies issues that need to be addressed.", "severity": 0.6, "before": "The Safety Office views safety oversight at DETEC as an integral system which incorporates people, technologies and structures to ensure safety."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Curando uno scambio regolare con i servizi interni ed esterni, il Safety Office individua i temi da trattare", "severity": 0.6, "before": "Il Safety Office considera in modo globale la vigilanza sulla sicurezza sistemica al DATEC."}]}
